context: A classroom greenhouse controller opens a roof window when the measured temperature rises above twenty-six degrees and closes it when the temperature falls below eighteen degrees. Between those thresholds it keeps the window in its current position. A shade cover reduces heating by sunlight, but it also reduces the light reaching the plants. In manual mode the controller stops moving the window automatically, while the temperature sensor continues recording measurements.
